name: clickllm — kernel development
//: A CUDA toolchain plus the tools that tell you whether a kernel helped.
clickllm does not ship kernels (CLAUDE.md invariant 1); it ships the seam
and the proof loop. This container is for the seam's users.
//image: NVIDIA's PyTorch image rather than a bare CUDA one: it already carries a
PyTorch built against this CUDA, which is the thing that is painful to
match by hand and the commonest reason a custom op fails to load.
//runArgs: --shm-size matters: PyTorch dataloaders and NCCL use /dev/shm, and the
Docker default of 64m produces a bus error that looks like a kernel bug.

remoteEnv.//TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST: Ampere through Hopper. Building for every arch triples compile time; building for none makes the op silently fall back to eager.
remoteEnv.//CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING: Set to 1 while debugging — async launches report errors at the *next* sync, so the stack trace points at innocent code.
